four_business_fields_actually_read.full_chain_observation: 实际注册IesniumGolem extends IronGolem及实体工厂，原生isInvulnerableTo(ServerLevel,DamageSource)：void先teleport world spawn并向上直到4个block检测可容身；weapon item实际IESNIUM_KNIFE tag直接return false；否则来源entity缺失或不crouching直接true，有crouching才super。实际actuallyHurt再次调用该gate，允许时先createShard再super：备份原HP→set满HP/resetFall/removeAllEffects/discard自己→保存本体entityData进fragile soul gem→恢复原HP→spawn掉落item。tag实际填入已注册iesnium butcher knife。
four_business_fields_actually_read.concrete_observation: 一个由攻击者当前姿态与来源携带的武器快照联合决定接受/拒伤并切换成保存物品的最终位点1，不是同源常量换壳。不把void恢复另外计数，归既有回场保护支持。knife直接false绕过本法super资格，不等于最终hurt必成功；非刀crouching也仍须super。void传送在最终拒绝前，且actuallyHurt重复查询还可再触发，故资格检查并非无副作用；while未显式y上界/步数上限，未运行验证极端地形。createShard发生在super真正扣血前，保存发生在discard后，不能据掉落已出现推断伤害/死亡成功；保存时刻移除态与后续真实载入行为未验。拒伤分支没有灰字/嗡鸣/专用回执。
four_business_fields_actually_read.application_to_boss_immune: Boss免控reason应来自专门控制入口和权威策略，不从来源姿态不允许/刀具交互收取/保存实体的hurt结果推导。应避免带位置/卸载/掉落副作用的资格方法反复调用；反馈只有明确最终拒控才发送。
four_business_fields_actually_read.limitations: 固定版本，完整实体类及直接注册/tag填充已读；未审复制模型/资产，未启动游戏，未验证native玩家攻击、极端地形、物品载入或像素。非Boss普通实体策略仅作语义反例，不增项目灰字要求，不按刀名/void/4空间检查加数。

four_business_fields_actually_read.full_chain_observation: 固定旧版6d3be813，@Init load→AddEntities真实注册Golem/TRock。构造23块身体槽，server onLivingUpdate激活/补缺，acquireRock生成behavior2随行石，Rock.native onEntityUpdate接近master后receiveRock回血+填缺槽。最终attackEntityFrom在非dying且非state1：胸口四块未全缺、openChest false时仅随机破身体块/播阻挡声、设仇恨，return true不走父HP伤害；openChest以缺任意槽且2格AABB内任意TRock为true，未核石头owner或behavior，故外来石也可开准入。通过后伤害cap5才super。
four_business_fields_actually_read.concrete_observation: 计1：真实世界修复载体接近反而开放核心伤害的空间准入，并非把有限盾资源换实体名。被挡返回true仍无parentHP变化；部分破槽可能drop物品/声音，不能称纹丝不动。state4直接false，state1也可returntrue但不伤，这两通用phase仅支持0。破块随机偏末端、槽4不可破，任意块缺失非仅胸口决定openChest前置。saveGolemCube发送实体id+slot/value到当前维度全部客户端，收包按当前world同ID/class再写槽，不验slot范围/UUID/维度代际，只有IOException catch。
four_business_fields_actually_read.application_to_boss_immune: Boss灰字必须来自实际控制拒绝语义，不能从true/false或未掉HP机械映射；目标定位包应含一致身份/维度并校验索引或枚举，观察者范围及缺失实体处理不能依赖旧式裸ID。此例身体槽/石头构建不移植为新资产。
four_business_fields_actually_read.limitations: 完整引用各关键方法已读，包括修复原生tick和接收全文方法；非整篇1280行Golem全文，generateBlock/translateOre材质映射不当新研究。原旧版整数伤害/dataWatcher/Packet250 API不可直接搬到本项目；网络线程/模型实际提交/声音听感未运行未验。本条研究最终gameplay准入及拒伤回执，S2C包装0，不制作身体模型。

four_business_fields_actually_read.full_chain_observation: 真实SERVER FreezeHealing在LivingHeal按frozen=round(blend(0,maxHealth*percentage,factor))预算，把heal amount限制0..max(0,unfrozen-currentHealth)。已列MixinLimitFoodRegen在原生FoodData.tick HEAD捕获player，再redirect自然回血gamerule，只现有效果map+非零percentage且当前HP达unfrozen上限则false。CLIENT FreezeHearts独立注册，真实Gui.renderHeart TAIL发RenderHeartEvent后按同公式draw冻结半/全/极限心overlay，RenderTick START重置heartIndex。
four_business_fields_actually_read.concrete_observation: 一个冻伤治疗上限实际拒绝/数量截断与反馈消费者整链1，不拆heal/native food path/heart painter三份，与AntiHeal简单status一律cancel和一次濒死leaf预算不同。不直接扣已有超上限HP；factor0解冻预算而不超原maxHealth。food redirect不重新调用test，默认map曾注册不等本次range合格；static STORED_PLAYER未finally清除，主tick关联只源码可见，不外推重入问题。HeartIndex仅container递增，overlay是原版画完后叠加，无取消原心绘制。client/server两个type与独立条件，数值同式不等跨端最终显示一致。
four_business_fields_actually_read.application_to_boss_immune: 可见反馈应表示实际预算/拒控语义，不能拿HUD冻结心替代Boss头顶拒控灰字；服务端最终裁决与独立本地重算必须分别记录并验收。
four_business_fields_actually_read.limitations: 主岗完整复读helper列出包含方法及原生注册/生命周期，额外固定默认数据和mixin清单/plugin已读；默认player启用冷效且普通entity effects空，不宣称自定义整包也如此。冷range原始min=-50/max=-100由betweenInclusive和blend正确处理反序，非未核实失效。Temperature.get→启用cap的BODY=CORE+BASE，resistance同cap trait；上游所有气候/装备/同步数值生产者、第三方全局listener次序及Forge内部派发未穷尽。动态注册的效果对象无cap所有者过滤字段，按事件实体做test；不据静态结构宣称跨实体实际叠乘或运行bug。无真实客户端/移动物理/网络/像素/声音验收，无正式修改或编译。食物回执和GUI仅真实原生注入源静态证据，未检查GUI/HUD冲突、Forge healing最终settlement或TCP一致性；并不计不相关通用GUI图形库。

four_business_fields_actually_read.full_chain_observation: 固定ELITE_KING_BAMBAMBAM实际factory→原生hurt保存旧HP比例并调用AoABoss/AoAMonster父结算，非technical来源且从>25%跨到<=25%才collapse；collapse显式setInvulnerable(true)经AoAMonster同步INVULNERABLE，并耗光energy。native fightTasks优先Rest，能量0才准入，start停导航/速度/路径并设同步EXHAUSTED与跟随声；controller实际读取EXHAUSTED播放倒地/起身。stop清EXHAUSTED、两次setInvulnerable(false)、补满energy。
four_business_fields_actually_read.concrete_observation: 一个跨实际血线后开启保护并借耗能休息阶段消费的独立实现1；不按22方法/866行/五minion/普通精英数值拆。阈值判断不直接要求super.hurt success为true，检查的是前后真实HP比例；technical源即使跨线不触发；不是这次造成跨线的伤害被回滚，也没有保底HP或alive保护，不能宣称致死一击被救活。非保护的普通energy0休息也设EXHAUSTED/同声同动画，故倒地声光不能识别保护flag、更不能当每次拒伤/拒控回执。Rest.shouldKeepRunning保护时true，否则energy!=150；runFor480/160是配置不是已读引擎最终截止保证。每5serverAITick加energy1、吸金物体近身heal50/addEnergy30，均不能自行推断提前解除保护。读档若原生invul flag仍true则HP改max/2并继续flagtrue；本类未保存energy/exhausted，sync默认150/false，不等于恢复原Rest或已证永久卡住。
four_business_fields_actually_read.application_to_boss_immune: Boss文字必须来自实际拒控分支，不能将通用阶段姿态/耗能声当免疫收据。状态同步和可见动画可以共用却有不同语义，需要区分保护flag、被拒原因与生命周期恢复。正式方案不增新Boss阶段，不从HP变化反推普通阴阳免疫文字。
four_business_fields_actually_read.limitations: 主岗完整866行精英类含Rest/Fireballs/五召唤匿名类/吸金物体、所列完整父hurt/read/save同步setter及具体factory已读；固定tree/blob/hash逐项核。SmartBrainLib HeldBehaviour调度和超时引擎未全文匹配，故不声称480/160必到期、读档必卡无敌或完成解除时序；原版invulnerability具体source bypass仍由父引擎决定，非无条件拒所有来源/控制。GeckoLib模型/动画资源与TME声音/粒子底层不展开、不做观感验收。五minion政策与已账共享家族0。Helper原文件仍credit0，主岗此整链晋级1；无生产修改/编译/游戏。

whole_old_owner_preserved_object.concrete_observation: 一个跨实际血线后开启保护并借耗能休息阶段消费的独立实现1；不按22方法/866行/五minion/普通精英数值拆。阈值判断不直接要求super.hurt success为true，检查的是前后真实HP比例；technical源即使跨线不触发；不是这次造成跨线的伤害被回滚，也没有保底HP或alive保护，不能宣称致死一击被救活。非保护的普通energy0休息也设EXHAUSTED/同声同动画，故倒地声光不能识别保护flag、更不能当每次拒伤/拒控回执。Rest.shouldKeepRunning保护时true，否则energy!=150；runFor480/160是配置不是已读引擎最终截止保证。每5serverAITick加energy1、吸金物体近身heal50/addEnergy30，均不能自行推断提前解除保护。读档若原生invul flag仍true则HP改max/2并继续flagtrue；本类未保存energy/exhausted，sync默认150/false，不等于恢复原Rest或已证永久卡住。
whole_old_owner_preserved_object.application_to_boss_immune: Boss文字必须来自实际拒控分支，不能将通用阶段姿态/耗能声当免疫收据。状态同步和可见动画可以共用却有不同语义，需要区分保护flag、被拒原因与生命周期恢复。正式方案不增新Boss阶段，不从HP变化反推普通阴阳免疫文字。
whole_old_owner_preserved_object.limitations: 主岗完整866行精英类含Rest/Fireballs/五召唤匿名类/吸金物体、所列完整父hurt/read/save同步setter及具体factory已读；固定tree/blob/hash逐项核。SmartBrainLib HeldBehaviour调度和超时引擎未全文匹配，故不声称480/160必到期、读档必卡无敌或完成解除时序；原版invulnerability具体source bypass仍由父引擎决定，非无条件拒所有来源/控制。GeckoLib模型/动画资源与TME声音/粒子底层不展开、不做观感验收。五minion政策与已账共享家族0。Helper原文件仍credit0，主岗此整链晋级1；无生产修改/编译/游戏。

four_business_fields_actually_read.full_chain_observation:
registered actual native handlers: Existing EvilCraft.onConfigsRegister adds actual EnchantmentUnusingConfig namedunusing. New EnchantmentConfig routes ENCHANTMENT and Forge registry through already-read shared factory/action callbacks; lazy getInstance invokes new EnchantmentUnusing, which registers this instance on MinecraftForge.EVENT_BUS. Constructor categoryBREAKABLE/mainhand, maxlevel1 and canEnchant(isDamageableItem) are acquisition declarations, not runtime event guards. Native enchanting/loot acquisition not expanded.
actual stack qualification and attack cancellation: NORMAL LivingAttack subscriber first checks target world server and source.getEntity instanceof LivingEntity. Uses that source actor CURRENT MAINHAND, not source.directEntity or a captured attack/projectile stack. EnchantmentHelpers loops raw getEnchantmentTags, compares registry key to each id ResourceLocation and returns first index; no lvl>0 test. If matchingid and unuseTooltrue, setCanceled(true) andreturn. It doesnot stopUsingItem (commented out). No positive damage/source-type/player/creative/target-immunity gate shown; not all entities but any qualifying Living source actor. No explicit alreadycanceled check; Forge dispatch of previously canceled events not expanded.
mutation at refusal boundary: unuseTool computes damageBorder=getMaxDamage()-5. If current getDamageValue>=border, first calls setDamageValue(border), then returns true causing actual cancel. This may request reducing damage from an overshot value to boundary, not simply prevent additional wear; later attempts at exactly boundary refuse again. If below boundary returnsfalse without modifying. No separate lock flag, elapsed timer, stored target, damage acknowledgement or retry counter. It does not check isDamageableItem in the runtime helper, so canEnchant does not prove malformed/enchant-injected stacks are excluded; lowmax negative parameter native normalization unverified.
mining arm and asymmetric release: NORMAL BlockEvent.BreakEvent gets player.getUsedItemHand before null-player check. If handnonnull, looks at that hand stack and same raw enchantid predicate, then unuseTool. On true cancels and calls releaseUsingItem. It doesnot explicitly side-check here or use original digging tool/mainhand unconditionally. Both event overloads share one policy; no perhand/method extra credit. The checked nullplayer condition cannot protect earlier dereferences; only conditional code observation, no engine-null event reproduction.
concrete recovery producer: Existing EvilCraft constructor installs BloodChestRepairActionRegistry; complete registry constructor registers DamageableItemRepairAction first and dispatches selected action. Blood chest/blockentity configs and actual BlockBloodChest.getTicker choose server BlockEntityTickingTankInventory.TickerServer. BlockEntityTickerDelayed.tick invokes update before optional update publication backoff. Server update reads each actual slot and, unless redstone disables ticker, passes current stack to TickComponent. Component chooses Item.class action, canTick, increments progress and invokes onTick; empty/failed qualification resets progress by configured flag. Redstone skips component call, thus doesnot itself reset progress.
repair commits changed stack for later reentry: RepairItemTickAction canTick requires nonempty tank/item plus actions.canRepair. At required ticks, copies stack, reselects action, simulates cost then if fluid amount sufficient invokes repair doAction=true. Damageable action requires isDamaged, requests setDamageValue(current-1), may add random bad enchant, returnsmultiplier1 with stack. Caller then requests tank drain and writes resulting stack to actual slot via inventory.setItem; SimpleInventory stores it in contents then inventory-change callback. No atomic debit guarantee; native drain internals and callback consumers unexpanded. Concrete conditional recovery: if a normal max100 stack at damage95 is repaired successfully to94 and later used in checked hand, unuseTool sees94<95 and doesnot cancel. No timer/reset packet; every action reads current damage. Native inventory transfer, ItemStack normalization and engine successful action remain outside proof.
termination and feedback boundaries: Refusal ceases when current selected stack lacks matching enchantid or current damage is below border; no retained peractor denial state to clear. Switching source mainhand also changes future attribution, including possible projectile-owned events; no originalweapon identity preserved. Source has no dedicated message/sound/particle/criterion or refusal packet. Mining releaseUsingItem is the only explicit use-state stop; native client correction/inventory synchronization not inspected. Blood chest open/close sound relates to openers, not repair success or immunity. No independent durable recovery receipt is claimed.
four_business_fields_actually_read.concrete_observation: One whole current source stack maxDamage-5 clamp before actual attack/break cancellation, and concrete normal repair producer lowers damage to re-admit. Actor equipment, thresholds, both event overloads, releaseUsingItem, blood chest actions/tank/ticks/storage and registry helpers add0 separately. Distinct from target finite shieldbudget/stun, burningNBT new-use/erosion/salvage, player faction/skill reason, independently live HUD requirements, deferred terminal payment, or presence of repair rocks opening another entity. Generic source-mainhand lookup is already present and earns0.033 still0.
four_business_fields_actually_read.application_to_boss_immune: Distinguish actor equipment refusal from target immunity, preserve the actual action stack identity, and define whether rejecting an attempt may mutate/restore resources. Reentry can be current-state-based without a retained lock, but feedback must state the real authoritative reason if added later.
four_business_fields_actually_read.limitations:
At most1 for whole current-stack wear clamp→two event refusals→conditional actual repair/reentry policy. Constants, helpers, two hands/events, source types and repair machine do not earn separate credit.
Source-actor equipment restriction is not Boss target immunity. No Boss gray text or actual rejected-control sound implemented/proven.
Clamping is before cancel; cross-mod final cancellation/side-effect ordering not executed. No rollback guarantee or native durability/inventory exploit claimed.
Enchantment match only identity/index; level0 can satisfy raw tag scan condition. Invalid ID parsing/no registry key may fail; no malformed input tested.
Attack currentMAINHAND versus mining getUsedItemHand, and mining-only release, are preserved as one whole policy—not extra variants.
Repair callback includes optional random bad-enchant branch using nextInt(maxLevel-minLevel). Equal min/max would make zero bound if selected. Such runtime branch not reproduced; successful recovery derivation explicitly assumes normal return/no exception.
Blood/tank/copy/tick/storage/creative/model registration and default parameter differences support0. GUI, textures, render resources and game untouched.
Pinned Core tag is source support, no exact build750 binary equivalence; no native event dispatch, ItemStack, packet, world or GUI execution.
Native enchanting acquisition, raw ItemStack getters/setters and Forge LivingAttack/Break dispatch/settlement. Actual registered mod handlers/parameters/cancel calls established; no survival acquisition, exact lowmax clamp result, all final outcomes or generic indestructibility claim.
Native releaseUsingItem, inventory replication, ordinary durability bar/client messages. No visible denial/recovery receipt or transport delivery claimed. Explicit local method has no dedicated cue.
Native block placement/ticker invocation, inventory transfer and tank drain internals; all auxiliary bad-enchant producers. Actual registered local tick/repair/write callback path read; no runtime machine transaction, debit or unconditional repair success. Recovery is conditional on completed normal repair and later item use.
Exact deployment equivalence for separately pinned Core support. Shared manifest/tag metadata verified only, no compiled binary matching.
Main independently read21 new ranges1849lines;11 exact034 already-read ranges reused unchanged. All32 manifest/tree/blob/range bindings checked. Seven prior judgments read, with repeated identical paragraph strings displayed once without dropping unique lines; all stored snapshot fields equal live471 records. Two additional whole substantive decision records actually read. Source counts and hashes add0.
TickComponent progress counter is saved separately by machine; skip due redstone does not run reset. BlockEntityTickerDelayed update executes before queued update publication backoff, so name delayed does not establish slower repair ticks or receipt delivery. SimpleInventory1..109 stops after complete setItem, not whole inventory callback implementation.
Repair canTick tests actual slot and tank; registry slot blacklist and canRepair loops differ, and arbitrary repair producers are not expanded. Complete recovery claim is conditional on normal successful Damageable repair, sufficient fluid and later selection of returned stack, not every input, exactly-once debit, native synchronization or survival acquisition.

comparisons.rationale: Whole actual-health-change text feedback remains existing owner; cracks are a category consumer, not new immunity/refusal.
Mod golem source posture/knife admission plus shard transformation remains whole; native renderer/repair does not reproduce or shrink that policy.
World repair-rock presence opens damage admission; native HP/ingot repair has no spatial core-unlock predicate. Difference alone is insufficient for new immune policy.
Actual heal amount clamp and independently recomputed hearts remain whole; using HP delta after heal is support, not a new cap/refusal owner.
Crossed HP threshold actually creates protection and rest-release state; native cracks change presentation only and cannot claim similar invulnerability.
Actual repair producer re-admits later current-tool attacks/mining; native ownHP repair does not add that actor-equipment gate. All generic mutation/repair/payment mechanics support0.
